entity.name: Othmane Morad
entity.description: Trilingual (Arabic/French/English) product designer and developer building open tools for correct Arabic and right-to-left interfaces in the AI-codegen era.

projects.name: rtlint
projects.description: An open-source CLI that finds and auto-fixes the Arabic/RTL bugs AI coding tools systematically introduce: physical instead of logical CSS, wrongly mirrored icons, broken bidirectional text, and Western numerals in Arabic contexts. It scans any React/Next/Tailwind repo, auto-fixes the mechanical failures, and writes an AI-rules file so codegen tools stop reintroducing them. Serves the ~500 million Arabic speakers underserved by machine-generated interfaces.

plans.name: Accuracy corpus + hosted audit
plans.description: One-time funding for compute to run the hosted Arabic/RTL audit engine and to build an open dataset of real-world RTL failures that improves detection accuracy.

plans.name: Sustain full-time RTL tooling
plans.description: Ongoing development of the rtlint CLI, hosted audit, and Arabic design-token layer as maintained open-source internationalization infrastructure.
